description: Rows of the nightly deterministic frame rig (.github/workflows/browser-frames.yml: chrome-headless-shell, CDP BeginFrame at 120 Hz, WebGPU on SwiftShader) that repeat within one build, read from an ADMITTED artifact by scripts/perf-ratchet/measure-browser-frames.mjs; partial or GPU-contaminated artifacts are refused. Each ceiling and tolerance is the verdict in scripts/perf/evidence/gpu-frame-timing-6975/frame-ratchet/repeatability.json (the seed build's maximum; twice the widest same-build spread, rounded up to 0.5%), recomputed by scripts/perf/frame-ratchet-evidence.test.mjs. Every other rig row is informational. Nightly only, not a PR gate. Raising a ceiling is a human PR with a justification (docs/guide/performance.md, 'Perf ratchet ceilings'); lowering is the daily perf-ratchet-lower.yml job, from the latest successful browser-frames run on main.

entries.description: GPUQueue.writeBuffer payload during the streaming load (geometry plus per-frame uploads), from the file-input change until the scene has rendered and gone idle
